bio: Brimming with character, this building by the Vecht River is enchanting, but just wait until you're sitting on the terrace… At Bistrotel, you can truly escape the hustle and bustle for a while! Before you retire to your comfortable guestroom, be sure to pop into the spacious bistro downstairs. André Gerrits has assembled a team here who know their way around bistro classics and flavours from all over the world. With options on the menu such as steak tartare, spicy rendang or farmhouse chicken from the spit; this is the kind of place where anything goes....
